description: This file 'utf8.h' contains function declarations, type definitions, macros, and constants related to UTF-8 string handling, encoding detection, and text alignment. It provides interfaces for managing UTF-8 encoded data, including byte width calculations, string width, encoding detection, re-encoding, and handling Unicode BOMs.

methods.name: display_mode_esc_sequence_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the escape sequence for a display mode given a string.

methods.name: utf8_width
methods.description: Determines the display width of a UTF-8 string, starting from a given position.

methods.name: utf8_strnwidth
methods.description: Computes the width of a UTF-8 string with a specified length, optionally skipping ANSI sequences.

methods.name: utf8_strwidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of an entire UTF-8 string.

methods.name: is_utf8
methods.description: Checks if a given text is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: is_encoding_utf8
methods.description: Determines if a given encoding name refers to UTF-8.

methods.name: same_encoding
methods.description: Checks whether two encoding names refer to the same encoding.

methods.name: utf8_fprintf
methods.description: Prints a formatted UTF-8 string to a FILE stream.

methods.name: skip_utf8_bom
methods.description: Skips the BOM in a UTF-8 string if present, updating the pointer and size.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_text
methods.description: Adds wrapped text into a strbuf with specified indentation and width.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_bytes
methods.description: Adds wrapped byte data into a strbuf with specified indentation and width.

methods.name: strbuf_utf8_align
methods.description: Aligns a UTF-8 string within a strbuf according to the specified alignment and width.

methods.name: reencode_string_iconv
methods.description: Re-encodes a string using iconv conversion, if available.

methods.name: char * reencode_string_len(const char * a UNUSED,size_t b UNUSED,const char * c UNUSED,const char * d UNUSED,size_t * e)
methods.description: Re-encodes a string to a specified encoding, returning a new string.

methods.name: char * reencode_string(const char * in,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding)
methods.description: Re-encodes a string to an output encoding, inferring encoding sizes.

methods.name: mbs_chrlen
methods.description: Returns the length of the multibyte character at the start of a string, given an encoding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgit
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.git' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitmodules
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.gitmodules' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitignore
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.gitignore' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitattributes
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.gitattributes' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotmailmap
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.mailmap' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: has_prohibited_utf_bom
methods.description: Determines if a UTF BOM is improperly used in an encoding context.

methods.name: is_missing_required_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks if a BOM is missing when required for certain encodings.

ctags.name: reencode_string
ctags.signature: (const char * in,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding)

ctags.name: reencode_string_len
ctags.pattern: /^static inline char *reencode_string_len(const char *a UNUSED, size_t b UNUSED,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * a UNUSED,size_t b UNUSED,const char * c UNUSED,const char * d UNUSED,size_t * e)
